name: Heart Rhythm 2027
description: Heart Rhythm is the Heart Rhythm Society's annual scientific meeting on cardiac electrophysiology and arrhythmia management. The 2027 meeting is scheduled for the Moscone Center in San Francisco with an online viewing option in addition to in person attendance.
